text: Karim's daughter Yasmin starts reception on the 4th, he's more nervous than she is lol. Text him that morning

Saskia picked up the new puppy Saturday - cockapoo called Biscuit. Already chewed through her charger and one of Karim's trainers. She's not sleeping, he cries in the crate all night, she's doing 2am and 5am wee trips. First jabs Thursday afternoon, then puppy classes from early December. She's obsessed though, sent me about forty photos

moira rang from the vets, her cat Pepper has some kidney thing, they're keeping him on a drip overnight and he's back in thurs at 10 for more bloods. she sounded rough, been crying i think. her son's away so she's on her own with it. offered to drive her thurs, she said she'd let me know. text her tonight
Yosef graduates end of the month from Leeds, engineering. His mum and dad are flying in from Haifa for it. Get him a card
Ayo said Abdi's got his GCSE mocks sometime next week and hasn't opened a book. She's at the end of her rope with him tbh
Esther - allergic to cats, which explains a lot about Sunday
so um Mustafa rang, his son Alfie passed his driving test this morning, first go, and he's already asked to borrow the car for Friday night. Mustafa's terrified
Pick up dog food and the flea stuff on way home. Also bin day tomorrow
Vera's dog Rolo turns 10 on the 12th and she's doing a little party for him in the park at half 2. I'm bringing sausages apparently
Gustavo + Phoebe getting married early March, somewhere in Lisbon. Save the date coming
Need to ring Mehmet sometime this week - his dad's had a fall and is in St James's
Lucy loves birdwatching, has a pair of binoculars she takes everywhere. Christmas idea: the RSPB guide she mentioned
Wei's PhD viva got cancelled, examiner's ill. Rescheduled for early December apparently, so she's in limbo

Dorota and Jonah's twins start nursery Monday 8am. Both of them in bits about it already, Dorota especially, she's back at work full time the same week so it's all landing at once. Jonah's mum is doing pickups Tuesdays and Thursdays. Twins are called Mila and Ayo, keep mixing them up. Dorota said they'd love a lunchbox each, the dinosaur ones
Coffee w Amy. She's moving to Bristol over the summer for a new job at the uni. Her partner Santiago is staying put till Christmas then following

Alana's hamster died. Kids devastated, the little one keeps asking when Nibbles is coming back. Alana's trying to explain it without making it worse and her husband's away with work till the 14th so she's doing bedtimes alone. Maybe drop round something small for the kids at the weekend, a book or something
Xavier Moreau (X) - new neighbour, two doors down, works nights at the hospital. Has a parrot that swears
Ethan sat his A level results day thing today - got into Manchester! Jen was crying on the phone. Must send congrats to both
Antoine's mum is in for her hip op on Tuesday at 7am. He's taking her, I'm doing the school run for his girls that day
keisha's dog went missing yesterday evening, found him this morning at the allotments, she's knackered
Note for later: Julien hates surprises. Do NOT do a surprise thing for his 40th
Caitlin got the all clear! Scan results came back Friday. Proper relief
Mila's little brother Ayo has his first piano recital on the 22nd at 6.30. She asked if I could come along, said yes
Zofia Nowak, the new head of year. Teaches chemistry, has a lurcher called Mabel, vegetarian. Very nice
Dentist moved to Wed 9.15. Car MOT end of the month. Book both into calendar
Karim and his wife are off to Morocco for half term, back the 3rd. Feed their cat while they're gone? Said I'd think about it
Must ask Saskia how Biscuit's first vet jab went on Thursday

Called Mum. Grandad's 90th is the 18th, lunch at the Swan at 1, then back to theirs for cake. She wants everyone to chip in for a memorial-style bench by the duck pond since he walks there every morning with the dog. Auntie Vera's sorting the plaque. Cousin Alfie can't come, he's in Australia till spring. Need to transfer her £40 before next Friday
Moira said Pepper's eating again, bloods better than expected. She's still worried but less so
Yosef's sister Esther is pregnant!! Due early April. He's going to be an uncle, he's buzzing
Spoke to Abdi after football. Mocks start Monday morning, history first. Seemed really anxious - text him good luck Sunday night
Mustafa says Alfie wants a dashcam for his car, hint hint, birthday's in Jan
Vera can't make book club this month, Rolo's having his teeth done on the Thursday
reminder: Gustavo's stag do is the last weekend of Jan, Porto. deposit to Mehmet by the 30th
Mehmet update - his dad's home now, physio twice a week. Mehmet's knackered from all the driving. Drop round with food sometime next week
Lucy's daughter Phoebe graduates from Durham on the 15th at 11am. Lucy's sorted a hotel for the night before. Proud mum moment incoming

Had lunch with Wei and her husband. They're thinking about getting a puppy in the spring but their landlord's being difficult about it. Wei's mum is visiting from Chengdu for six weeks from mid November, so it might wait till after
Jonah texted a photo of the twins in their nursery uniforms. Apparently Mila (the older one, not Ayo's sister) cried at the door but was fine by lunch
Amy's leaving do is Friday at 5 at the Crown. Card's going round the office tomorrow morning - sign it
Alana's eldest, Xavier, has his 11+ exam on Saturday the 9th at 9am. She says he's calm but she's a wreck. Wish him luck Friday

Ethan's off to Manchester on the 20th, Jen and his dad are driving him up early that morning, car packed the night before. He's doing physics. Jen's putting a brave face on but she's not ok about it, he's the first to leave. Their old dog Bramble is going to miss him the most honestly, sleeps on his bed every night. Ask Jen round for a glass of wine the week after
antoine says op went fine, mum's home thurs. check in w him tomorrow evening
Keisha mentioned she's been doing a pottery course on Tuesday nights. Loves it. Wants her own wheel eventually
Julien's birthday dinner moved from Saturday to Sunday at 7, same place. Partner Ethan organising
Caitlin's cat Miso had kittens! Five of them. She's giving them away end of the month. Do I want one?? Thinking no

ok voice note. so Zofia was telling me her son Jonah starts secondary in September, he's dead set on the one across town but they've not heard back yet. Results due early March. Also she said her husband's been made redundant from the factory, last day is end of next month, so things are a bit stressful at home. Should probably ask her for coffee at some point next week
Gym Mon Wed Fri 6.30am from next week. Meal prep Sunday. No excuses
Dorota's mum lives with them now, she's got early dementia. Dorota's doing everything. Mustn't forget to ask how she's coping

Long chat with Yasmin. Her and Karim are finally doing the extension, builders start sometime in November and they'll be living with her parents for at least six weeks. Two kids, the dog, the in-laws, one bathroom. She laughed but you could tell she's dreading it. Also mentioned their eldest Alfie has his Year 6 SATs in May and they've got a tutor lined up from January
Moira's grandson starts uni next week
Mehmet Osei retiring at Christmas after 31 years at the council. Party sometime mid December, details tbc
Esther and her husband Abdi had their scan Tuesday afternoon, all fine. It's a girl. They're not telling his parents till Sunday lunch
Vera - her budgie Kiwi died over the weekend. She's had him 12 years. Send her a card
Phone Phoebe re: graduation photos, she wants copies of the ones I took

Talked to Gustavo on the phone forever, nearly an hour. Phoebe's dad isn't well, heart stuff, and they're wondering whether to push the wedding back to the summer so he can be there properly. Nothing decided yet. Gustavo's stressed, work's mental too, he's got his promotion review on the 28th at 2pm. Ring him after the review to see how it went
Santiago's ankle is still bad from the 10k. Physio says no running till the new year
Took Lucy's dog out this morning while she's at her mum's. Again tomorrow 8am and Saturday
Jen says the open day for Ethan's little sister Mila is Saturday 10-2. They're all going
Saskia's dad Uncle Wei is visiting from Singapore sometime next month, wants to meet the puppy
Ayo's nan passed away last night. Funeral probably end of next week. Must message her today
